objective: Auditar en SQL canónica real las entidades necesarias para Cavas Personales BOS V1.0 antes de crear o alterar esquema. Confirmar qué ya existe para clientes, unidades, productos/catálogos extendidos, Cavas legacy, configuraciones, horarios/zonas/monedas y relaciones. No crear tablas ni columnas. No tocar Producción. Dejar evidencia versionada del gate y ejecutar solo SELECT mediante sql_readonly_audit.

actions.content:
# EKS CAVAS 003 - Gate de auditoría canónica SQL

## Objetivo
Este gate impide crear o duplicar esquema de Cavas sin inspeccionar primero la SQL canónica real de EDARSAHUB.

## Alcance
- Cliente canónico / CRM.
- Unidad de negocio / empresa.
- Tablas Cava legacy existentes.
- Producto/catálogo e inventario relacionado.
- Catálogo extendido si existe.
- Configuraciones, zonas horarias, monedas y horarios operativos reutilizables.

## Regla
No se autoriza DDL de Cavas hasta que el resultado READ_ONLY_SQL determine qué entidades deben reutilizarse y cuáles, en su caso, deben convertirse en canónicas y atómicas.

## Resultado esperado
El resultado del Worker asociado a `CAVAS-BOS-V1-CANONICAL-AUDIT-01` es la evidencia vinculante para el siguiente slice de implementación.

queries.name: cavas_tables_and_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE 'CavaSocios[_]%' ORDER BY t.name, c.column_id

queries.name: canonical_client_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('Cliente_Catalogo','Clientes','CRM_Clientes') ORDER BY t.name, c.column_id

queries.name: business_unit_company_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Empresas','Sistema_Empresas') ORDER BY t.name, c.column_id

queries.name: product_catalog_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Catalogo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Insumo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Presentacion%' ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: product_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (t.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Catalogo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Insumo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Presentacion%') AND (c.name LIKE '%Codigo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Nombre%' OR c.name LIKE '%Marca%' OR c.name LIKE '%Familia%' OR c.name LIKE '%Alcohol%' OR c.name LIKE '%PublicUUID%' OR c.name LIKE '%ProductoID%' OR c.name LIKE '%InsumoID%') ORDER BY t.name, c.column_id

queries.name: extended_catalog_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.name LIKE '%Extend%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ampliad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Externo%' ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: canonical_operational_context
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.name LIKE '%TurnosOperativos%' OR t.name LIKE '%Zona%Horaria%' OR t.name LIKE '%Moneda%' OR t.name LIKE '%Idioma%' OR t.name LIKE '%Configuracion%' ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: cavas_constraints_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, i.is_unique, i.has_filter, i.filter_definition FROM sys.tables t LEFT JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id AND i.index_id>0 WHERE t.name LIKE 'CavaSocios[_]%' ORDER BY t.name, i.name

queries.name: cavas_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table, fk.name AS fk_name, OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) LIKE 'CavaSocios[_]%' ORDER BY parent_table, fk.name
